svg.title: Women and men in each pay quartile, 5 April 2026
svg.desc: Percentage of women and men in the four hourly-pay quartiles. Lower: women 77.4%, men 22.6%. Lower middle: women 71.0%, men 29.0%. Upper middle: women 74.2%, men 25.8%. Upper: women 53.2%, men 46.8%. Each quartile has 62 full-pay relevant employees.
